summary: Sodexo operates the Everyday digital dining platform with mobile/kiosk ordering, digital wallet/contactless payment, memberships/loyalty and pickup/delivery capabilities.
Sodexo's Spark platform combines technology, AI, data and human expertise; Spark IQ converts operational signals into real-time client insights and analytics.
Sodexo won Meta's global food-services contract covering 130+ locations in 30+ countries, using a global operating model with advanced digital and data capabilities.
